description_en: Attach an existing IP access control policy
description_zh: 绑定某个已存在的IP访问控制
kebab_example: aliyun iotcc associate-ip-with-connection-pool --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --iot-cloud-connector-id iotcc-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --connection-pool-id cp-bp11234abctmno0hdq0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AssociateIpWithConnectionPool

parameters.help_en:
Ensures idempotence of the request.
Generate a unique value from your client for this parameter to guarantee uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。
从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run of the request. Valid values:
true: Sends a dry run request without actually binding the IP addresses to the connection address pool associated with the cloud connector. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, whether the request format is valid, and whether business limits are exceeded. If the check fails, an error is returned. If the check passes, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): Sends a normal request. After passing all checks, the IP addresses are bound to the connection address pool associated with the cloud connector
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会将IP地址与云连接器关联的连接地址池绑定。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接将IP地址与云连接器关联的连接地址池绑定
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the cloud connector instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html API to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the cloud connector
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the connection address pool
parameters.name: connection_pool_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of IP addresses to bind.
You can specify up to 500 IP addresses. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
要绑定的IP地址列表。
最多支持传入500个IP地址。多个IP地址使用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: ips

parameters.help_en:
The OSS path of the template file, which corresponds to the OssPath parameter returned by the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313331.html API.

The format is `<BucketName>/<uid>/<FileName>`.

You cannot specify both Ips and IpsFilePath. If you have a small number of IP addresses, use Ips. If you have a large number of IP addresses, we recommend using IpsFilePath to record all IP addresses in a template file for bulk binding
parameters.help_zh:
模板文件OSS地址，即https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313331.html接口的返回参数**OssPath**。

格式为`<BucketName>/<uid>/<FileName>`。

Ips和IpsFilePath不能同时填写，如果IP数量较少，可直接选择Ips方式，如果IP数量较多，建议选择IpsFilePath方式，将需要绑定的IP地址记录在模板文件中，整体绑定
parameters.name: ips_file_path
